note.en: The ninth digit closes an ISO 7064 MOD 11,10 run over the eight before it, which is the rule the BZSt publishes for the USt-IdNr. A serial of zeros closes that run too, so the zero number is denied by name.
Structure only. The Steuernummer is issued by the Land's tax office in its own numbering, and no national check-digit rule is published for it, so the format is the whole of what can be checked.
Electronic address for e-invoice routing: the EAS scheme code plus your identifier. Carry it now and the card is already correct when a counterparty moves to Peppol.
note.es: Dirección electrónica para el enrutamiento de facturas: el código de esquema EAS más tu identificador. Tenerlo ya deja la tarjeta lista cuando una contraparte pase a Peppol.

note.en: Every business has had to be able to RECEIVE structured e-invoices since January 2025. Issuing becomes mandatory in January 2027 above EUR 800,000 of prior-year turnover and in January 2028 for everyone else.
